title: Responsible AI
objective: Be able to select measures by linking fairness, explainability, transparency, safety, and controllability to risks.

sections.title: Responsible AI Is an Ongoing Design Challenge
paragraphs: Responsible AI addresses fairness, explainability, privacy and security, safety, controllability, accuracy and robustness, governance, and transparency according to the intended use. In applications that significantly affect people, such as hiring assistance, it is especially important to be able to verify the basis for decisions and to retain human judgment.

sections.title: Verify representativeness and subgroups, and validate the controls
paragraphs: Identify bias in the input data, misuse, exposure of sensitive information, and harmful outputs. Confirm that the data represents the target population and that there are no performance differences across subgroups based on attributes or usage conditions. Evaluate not only performance but also whether impacts can be explained. Bedrock Guardrails can filter input and output content and sensitive information against policies, but they do not replace IAM authentication and authorization, human approval, or validation that the configuration is appropriate for the intended use.

sections.title: Using Transparency, Sustainability, and Model Cards in Decision-Making
paragraphs: Overfitting occurs when a model fits the training data too closely, while underfitting occurs when it fails to learn the patterns it needs. A model card is a resource for reviewing intended uses, limitations, evaluations, and responsible-use choices. Choose models by comparing not only performance but also explainability, resource consumption, and transparency for users with the impact of the intended use.

checkpoints.prompt: The head of the recruiting department is introducing AI to summarize application materials. What is an appropriate design when the summaries may influence hiring decisions?

choices.text: Automatically hire based on the AI's summaries without showing the reasoning.
choices.explanation: This is inappropriate for a use case with a significant impact on people.

choices.text: Explain the purpose and limitations of the system so that the responsible staff can compare the summaries with the original documents and make the decision.
choices.explanation: This ensures transparency and preserves human judgment.

choices.text: Skip consideration of bias if more input data is provided.
choices.explanation: Increasing the amount of input data alone cannot eliminate bias.

checkpoints.prompt: A call center quality manager is evaluating AI that converts users’ speech into text. The overall error rate met the benchmark, but it was reported that error rates differ depending on speaking style. Before expanding the service’s scope, select one evaluation that should be performed first.

choices.text: Measure only the overall error rate again on a different day and confirm that it still meets the same benchmark.
choices.explanation: Looking only at the overall value can miss errors that occur with specific speaking styles.

choices.text: Collect sufficient validation data for each speaking style being considered, then compare the error rates and error patterns under the same conditions.
choices.explanation: Separating the results by user group makes it possible to investigate performance differences that may not appear in the overall average.

choices.text: Estimate the error rate for the smaller group from the evaluation results of the larger group.
choices.explanation: When the training data or speech characteristics differ, error patterns can also differ. Smaller groups should likewise be evaluated using validation data.

choices.text: Exclude the group with the most errors from the overall aggregation and decide the service scope based on the remaining results.
choices.explanation: Excluding a group that is expected to use the service prevents evaluation of the impact on those users.

checkpoints.prompt: Municipal operations staff need to investigate incorrect guidance from a resident-assistance AI. Which record is most appropriate?

choices.text: Record the model and configuration versions, evaluations, approvals, and changes.
choices.explanation: This makes reproduction and improvement possible.

choices.text: Guess the configuration later and rewrite it.
choices.explanation: The state at the time cannot be reproduced.
